metadata.thread_control_limit: Environment limits common BLAS/OpenMP runtimes; not a guarantee for every native library.

protocol.plot_title: Profile-guided 2D repair: faster processing, identical geometry
protocol.execution: Serial fresh workers; randomized case order and cyclic method order; every method occupies every position once per four repeats.
protocol.timed: Repair, source bands or profile-only extraction, and native color assembly with intrinsic checks. core_s is the directly comparable complete geometry processing time.
protocol.excluded: Imports, input loading, common warmup, fingerprints, external audits, export, slicer work and printing.
protocol.optimized_first_stage: Both 2D arms extract profiles only; no discarded source prisms. matched_part_bands_s is intentionally null for both.
protocol.audit_policy: Reuse archived final-output audits only on exact original input, numeric settings, library versions, output counts and native geometry/name/color/layer hashes; preserve generic audit failures and supplementary cap proof.
protocol.normalization: Original per-part layer indices, original global Z origin, identical 0.001 mm Z gap and midpoint assignment.
protocol.limitations: Local desktop; no CPU pinning or isolation from background applications. Environment thread limits do not cover every possible native runtime.

execution_plan.native_stage: material partition and one final extrusion with mandatory intrinsic checks

settings.gap_policy: both ends of every nominal band trimmed by 0.0005 mm, including outer boundaries
settings.assembly: contour_optimized: profile-only source stage, partition_materials, one final extrusion with native intrinsic checks
